title: Mijn verhaal — jouw eerste voorstelrondje
summary: Week 1 recap across greetings, zijn, hebben and de/het — then your first real self-introduction

blocks.title: Week 1 — you did it
blocks.body: Look how much you can already do: greet by the hour, order a coffee, say who you are with *zijn*, say what you have with *hebben*, and label a noun *de* or *het*. Today we knit it together and you introduce yourself in Dutch for the first time. This is the start of **mijn verhaal** — your story — which grows a little every week.
blocks.callout: Everything today is a recap except the last two blocks. Those are new: your self-intro.

blocks.prompt: It's 20:00 and you arrive at a dinner. Which greeting fits?
blocks.explain: After ~18:00 it's *goedenavond*. Morning and afternoon have passed.

blocks.prompt: Complete with *zijn*: Wij ___ hier. (We are here.)
blocks.hint: Plural subjects all take one form.
blocks.explain: *Wij zijn hier.* Every plural — *wij, jullie, zij* — uses *zijn*.

blocks.prompt: Complete with *hebben*: Hij ___ een hond. (He has a dog.)
blocks.explain: *Hij heeft een hond.* Only *ik heb* and *jij hebt* break from *heeft* in the singular.

blocks.prompt: Choose the right negation: Ik heb ___ auto. (I have no car.)
blocks.explain: *auto* here is a bare noun (an *een*-noun), so 'no car' = *geen auto*. *niet* negates verbs and qualities, not bare nouns.
*meisje* ends in *-je*, a diminutive, and every *-je* word is *het*: *het meisje*.

blocks.prompt: Listen and type — a full self-intro line.
blocks.explain: *Ik ben nieuw hier* — I'm new here. A line you'll actually use this week.

blocks.scene: Emma introduces you to Daan at the café. Your turn to speak for yourself.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.nl: Daan, dit is een vriend van mij. Hij leert Nederlands.
lines.en: Daan, this is a friend of mine. He's learning Dutch.

lines.speaker: Daan
lines.spotlight: *Waar kom je vandaan?* = Where are you from? Learn it as a set phrase.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Ik kom uit Canada. Ik ben hier nieuw.
lines.en: I'm from Canada. I'm new here.
lines.spotlight: *Ik kom uit …* + country. Your go-to origin line.

lines.speaker: Daan
lines.nl: En je spreekt al Nederlands, echt goed hoor!
lines.en: And you already speak Dutch, really well!

questions.q: How do you ask 'where are you from?'
To say your country of origin you start with…

blocks.title: Mijn verhaal — laag 1
blocks.prompt: Build your first self-introduction: your name, where you're from, and that you're learning Dutch. Pick one chip per slot, then say the whole thing out loud.

slots.label: What you're doing
chips: Ik leer Nederlands en ik heb er zin in

blocks.sample: Ik ben Alex. Ik kom uit Canada. Ik leer Nederlands en ik heb er zin in.

blocks.prompt: Write your own mijn verhaal — real this time. Your name, your country, and that you're learning Dutch. Three or four lines using *ben*, *kom* and *heb*. This is layer 1; you'll add to it every week.
